subject: Anthropic’s European angels win big
notes: Items are teasers linking to full articles; details are limited to the teaser lines. The deal list line for Gradyent has an empty co-investor list in the issue.

stories.headline: Anthropic listed last week; European angels who backed it expect returns of up to 25x
stories.quote: My colleague Daphné Leprince-Ringuet spoke to a host of European angels who backed the AI lab before its historic listing last week, with some expecting returns of 25x on their investments.

facts.text: Italian angel Gianluca Cocco invested at a $183bn valuation last year and is sitting on a potential 6x return.
facts.quote: Take Italian investor Gianluca Cocco, who missed the chance to invest in Anthropic at a $20bn valuation in 2024, before finally getting in at $183bn last year. Despite the delay, he's now sitting on a potential 6x return.

facts.text: Some European angels expect returns of 25x on their Anthropic investments.

facts.text: The issue calls the IPO a blockbuster that gave some European angels a payday.
facts.quote: But Anthropic's blockbuster IPO has given some of the continent's angels a rather nice payday of their own.
